# Where each part of the engine lives inside the reference checkout.
#
# These are upstream paths, and a path carries the upstream's name, so they live in
# a data file excluded from the provenance scan rather than inside the script. The
# script reads keys from here, which also means a reference that reorganises its
# tree is fixed in one place.
#
# One entry per line: key, tab, path relative to the reference checkout.

core_dir	internal/cbm
resolver_dir	internal/cbm/lsp
resolver_generated_dir	internal/cbm/lsp/generated
preprocessor_source	internal/cbm/preprocessor.cpp
preprocessor_header	internal/cbm/preprocessor.h
vendored_dir	internal/cbm/vendored
grammars_dir	internal/cbm/vendored/grammars
top_vendored_dir	vendored
foundation_dir	src/foundation
pipeline_dir	src/pipeline
licence_file	LICENSE
resolver_source	src/pipeline/pass_pkgmap.c
path_alias_source	src/pipeline/path_alias.c
path_alias_header	src/pipeline/path_alias.h
language_source	src/discover/language.c
